name: Golden Hour Latte
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Saffron-honey syrup* — 15 ml; Whole milk (or oat) — 200 ml; Crushed pistachio — 1 g; Saffron threads (garnish) — 3 threads
method: 1. *Syrup: steep 0.4 g saffron in 50 g hot water 15 min, stir into 100 g honey. Keep chilled up to 2 weeks. 2. Pull the double espresso directly onto the syrup in a pre-warmed 12 oz cup and stir. 3. Steam milk to 60–65 °C with fine microfoam; pour in a tight rosetta. 4. Dust with pistachio and float three saffron threads.

name: First Light
ingredients: Espresso, shot (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Tonic water — 120 ml; Yuzu juice — 15 ml; Honey syrup (1:1) — 10 ml; Ice — 150 g; Dehydrated lemon wheel + thyme — 1 + 1 sprig
method: 1. Fill a tall glass with ice; add yuzu juice and honey syrup, stir briefly. 2. Top with tonic water, pouring down a spoon to keep carbonation. 3. Pull the espresso and pour slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats as a layer. 4. Garnish with dehydrated lemon and thyme. Serve unstirred.

name: Dusk Ember
ingredients: Double espresso — 36 ml; Medjool date syrup* — 20 ml; Whole milk — 180 ml; Cinnamon stick (torched) — 1 small; Flaked sea salt — 1 pinch
method: 1. *Syrup: simmer 100 g pitted Medjool dates with 200 ml water 15 min, blend and strain. 2. Combine espresso and date syrup in a warm cup. 3. Steam milk to 62 °C and pour; finish with salt. 4. Torch the cinnamon stick, rest it on the saucer and cloche briefly for aroma at the table.

name: Midnight Sesame
ingredients: Double espresso — 36 ml; Black sesame cream* — 25 g; Whole milk (or oat) — 200 ml; Toasted white sesame — 1 g
method: 1. *Cream: grind 100 g toasted black sesame to a paste, blend with 40 g honey and 20 g water. 2. Whisk sesame cream with espresso until smooth. 3. Add steamed milk (hot) or milk over ice (iced). Stir. 4. Finish with toasted sesame.

name: Rose Cloud Cold Brew
ingredients: Cold brew (ready to drink) — 200 ml; Ice — 120 g; Heavy cream — 30 ml; Milk (2%) — 30 ml; Vanilla syrup — 8 ml; Rose water — 0.5 ml (≈ 8 drops); Dried rose petals — 0.3 g
method: 1. Pour cold brew over ice. 2. Froth cream, milk, vanilla and rose water for 15–20 s until pourable and thick. 3. Float foam over the coffee and scatter petals.

name: Hazelnut Noir Mocha
ingredients: Double espresso — 36 ml; 70% dark chocolate couverture — 25 g; Hazelnut praline paste — 12 g; Whole milk — 190 ml; Cacao nibs + hazelnut crumb — 2 g
method: 1. Melt chocolate in 20 ml hot water with praline, whisk to a ganache in the cup. 2. Pull espresso into the ganache and stir. 3. Steam milk to 60 °C and pour, keeping texture glossy. 4. Finish with nibs and crumb.

name: Neroli Cortado
ingredients: Double espresso — 36 ml; Steamed whole milk — 90 ml; Orange blossom honey — 8 g; Orange blossom water — 0.5 ml (≈ 2 drops); Orange zest — 1 twist
method: 1. Dissolve honey in the fresh espresso; add orange blossom water (taste first — it is potent). 2. Pour in 90 ml of lightly textured milk. 3. Express orange zest over the surface and drop in.

name: Monsoon
ingredients: Cold brew — 180 ml; Pandan syrup* — 15 ml; Coconut cream — 30 ml; Oat milk — 20 ml; Simple syrup — 5 ml; Ice — 120 g; Toasted coconut flakes + pandan leaf knot — garnish
method: 1. *Syrup: blend 5 pandan leaves with 100 ml water, strain, simmer with 100 g sugar. 2. Layer pandan syrup, ice and cold brew. 3. Froth coconut cream, oat milk and simple syrup; float on top. 4. Garnish with coconut flakes and a knotted pandan leaf.

name: Amber Miso
ingredients: Double espresso — 36 ml; Maple-miso caramel* — 20 ml; Whole milk (or oat) — 200 ml; Flaked sea salt + black sesame — pinch
method: 1. *Caramel: whisk 20 g white (shiro) miso into 120 ml warm maple syrup, reduce 5 min on low heat. Cool. 2. Whisk caramel into hot espresso until dissolved. 3. Add steamed milk or milk over ice. Taste and adjust — miso brands vary in salt.

name: Sunset Spritz
ingredients: Espresso shot, chilled — 36 ml; Tamarind syrup* — 20 ml; Lime juice — 10 ml; Sparkling water — 120 ml; Ice — 150 g; Orange wheel, chilli-salt rim — garnish
method: 1. *Syrup: simmer 40 g tamarind pulp, 40 g sugar and 100 ml water 8 min; strain. 2. Rim half the glass with chilli-lime salt; fill with ice. 3. Add tamarind syrup, lime and sparkling water; stir. 4. Float chilled espresso on top; garnish with orange wheel.

name: Silk Road Cappuccino
ingredients: Double espresso — 36 ml; Cardamom-cinnamon syrup* — 12 ml; Whole milk — 150 ml; Toasted almond slivers — 2 g; Ground cardamom — pinch
method: 1. *Syrup: crush 6 cardamom pods, simmer with 1 cinnamon stick in 100 g sugar + 100 ml water 10 min; strain. 2. Pull espresso onto syrup and stir. 3. Steam milk to 62 °C with dense, glossy foam; pour a classic cappuccino. 4. Top with almonds and a pinch of cardamom.

name: Ube Cloud Latte
ingredients: Ube halaya (purple yam jam) — 25 g; Whole milk — 180 ml; Coconut milk — 20 ml; Espresso (optional) — 36 ml; Ube crumb — 1 g
method: 1. Whisk ube halaya with 30 ml hot milk until smooth. 2. Add espresso (if using) and remaining steamed milk and coconut milk. 3. Garnish with ube crumb. Serve over ice for the iced version.

name: Hojicha Honey Iced
ingredients: Hojicha powder — 3 g; Hot water (80 °C) — 40 ml; Honey — 12 g; Oat milk — 180 ml; Ice — 130 g
method: 1. Whisk hojicha powder and hot water to a smooth paste; dissolve honey in it. 2. Fill glass with ice, add oat milk, then pour the hojicha concentrate over. 3. Serve with a stir stick.

name: Burnt Honey Affogato
ingredients: Vanilla bean gelato — 90 g; Hot espresso — 36 ml; Burnt honey* — 10 g; Shortbread crumb + sea salt — 2 g
method: 1. *Burnt honey: cook honey over medium heat to deep amber (~140 °C) with a pinch of salt; cool. 2. Scoop gelato into a chilled glass; drizzle with burnt honey. 3. Serve with espresso in a small pitcher to pour at the table.

name: Espresso
ingredients: House blend, ground to order — 9 g; Yield in cup — ≈ 18 g
method: 1. Purge group, dose 9 g into the single basket, level and tamp level (≈ 15 kg). 2. Extract 25–30 s to 18 g into a pre-warmed 2 oz cup. 3. Serve immediately with a small sparkling-water chaser.

name: Doppio
ingredients: House blend, ground to order — 18 g; Yield in cup — ≈ 36 g
method: 1. Dose 18 g into the double basket, level and tamp. 2. Extract 25–30 s to 36 g; adjust grind (not dose) to hit time. 3. Serve immediately in a pre-warmed 3 oz cup.

name: Cortado
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Whole milk, steamed — 85 ml
method: 1. Pull the double into a 4 oz glass. 2. Steam milk to 60 °C with minimal foam; pour to equal parts coffee and milk.

name: Americano
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Hot filtered water (88 °C) — 220 ml
method: 1. Pull the double into a 12 oz cup. 2. Add hot water; do not pour over the crema.

name: Long Black
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Hot filtered water (88 °C) — 140 ml
method: 1. Add hot water to an 8 oz cup first. 2. Pull the double directly on top to keep the crema.

name: Cappuccino
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Whole milk, steamed — 140 ml
method: 1. Pull the double into a 6 oz cup. 2. Steam milk to 62 °C with ~1 cm of dense, glossy foam. 3. Pour to form a thick crown; no powders.

name: Oat Cappuccino
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Barista oat milk, steamed — 140 ml
method: 1. Pull the double into a 6 oz cup. 2. Steam oat milk to 60 °C (do not exceed — it splits). 3. Pour as a cappuccino.

name: Latte
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Whole milk, steamed — 250 ml
method: 1. Pull the double into a 12 oz cup. 2. Steam milk to 62 °C with fine microfoam; pour with a 5–8 mm foam layer.

name: Flat White
ingredients: Ristretto double (18 g in / 28 g out) — 28 ml; Whole milk, steamed — 120 ml
method: 1. Pull a ristretto double (≈ 20 s) into a 6 oz cup. 2. Steam to 60 °C with thin, velvety microfoam; pour with no visible foam cap.

name: Vanilla Bean Latte
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Vanilla bean syrup — 15 ml; Whole milk — 240 ml hot / 180 ml iced; Ice (iced only) — 150 g
method: 1. Add syrup to the cup, pull the double onto it and stir. 2. Hot: add steamed milk. Iced: add ice and cold milk, stir.

name: Dark Chocolate Mocha
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; 70% dark chocolate couverture — 25 g; Hot water — 20 ml; Whole milk — 230 ml hot / 180 ml iced; Ice (iced only) — 150 g
method: 1. Melt chocolate in the hot water, whisk to a ganache in the cup. 2. Pull the double onto the ganache and stir. 3. Add steamed milk (hot) or ice and cold milk (iced).

name: White Chocolate Mocha
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; White chocolate couverture — 30 g; Hot water — 20 ml; Whole milk — 230 ml hot / 180 ml iced; Ice (iced only) — 150 g
method: 1. Melt white chocolate in the hot water, whisk smooth in the cup. 2. Pull the double onto it, stir; add milk (steamed or cold over ice).

name: Cold Brew
ingredients: Coffee, coarse ground (batch) — 100 g; Cold filtered water (batch) — 1000 ml; Serving: cold brew + ice — 200 ml + 120 g
method: 1. Combine grounds and water, stir, steep covered at 4 °C for 16 h. 2. Filter through paper, store chilled ≤ 5 days. 3. Serve 200 ml over ice in a 16 oz cup.

name: Iced Latte
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Cold whole milk — 180 ml; Ice — 150 g
method: 1. Fill a 16 oz cup with ice and add milk. 2. Pull the double and pour over.

name: Iced Americano
ingredients: Double espresso (18 g in / 36 g out) — 36 ml; Cold filtered water — 150 ml; Ice — 150 g
method: 1. Fill a 16 oz cup with ice and water. 2. Pull the double and pour over.

name: Iced Matcha Latte
ingredients: Ceremonial matcha — 3 g; Water (80 °C) — 60 ml; Cold whole milk (or oat) — 180 ml; Simple syrup (optional) — 10 ml; Ice — 130 g
method: 1. Sift matcha, whisk with 80 °C water to a smooth paste (no lumps). 2. Fill a 16 oz cup with ice and milk; pour matcha over.

name: Iced Spiced Chai
ingredients: Chai concentrate* — 90 ml; Cold whole milk — 120 ml; Ice — 130 g
method: 1. *Concentrate: simmer 40 g black tea, 30 g sliced ginger, 8 cardamom pods, 4 cloves, 2 cinnamon sticks in 1 L water 15 min; strain, dissolve 150 g sugar; chill. 2. Fill cup with ice, add concentrate then milk; stir.

name: Hibiscus Berry Cooler
ingredients: Hibiscus tea concentrate* — 120 ml; Mixed berries, muddled — 30 g; Lemon juice — 10 ml; Simple syrup — 15 ml; Crushed ice — 150 g; Sparkling water — 60 ml
method: 1. *Concentrate: steep 10 g dried hibiscus in 500 ml hot water 10 min; strain, chill. 2. Muddle berries with syrup and lemon, add ice and concentrate, top with sparkling water.

name: Single-Origin Pour Over (V60)
ingredients: Single-origin coffee, medium-fine — 15 g; Water (93 °C) — 250 g
method: 1. Rinse the paper filter; add coffee. 2. Bloom with 45 g water for 30 s. 3. Pour in slow spirals to 250 g by 1:30; let drain. 4. Target total time 2:45–3:15; serve with tasting notes.

name: Espresso Flight
ingredients: Three single-origin coffees, each 9 g in / 18 g out — 3 × 18 g; Sparkling water — 90 ml
method: 1. Pull three single shots from three origins (dedicated grinder dose). 2. Serve in 1.5 oz cups on a tray with the sparkling water and origin cards.

name: Burnt Basque Cheesecake
ingredients: Cream cheese — 600 g; Sugar — 180 g; Eggs — 3 (≈ 150 g); Heavy cream — 300 ml; Plain flour — 15 g; Vanilla extract / salt — 5 ml / 2 g
method: 1. Beat cheese and sugar smooth; add eggs one by one, then cream, flour, vanilla, salt. 2. Pour into a paper-lined tin; bake 220 °C ≈ 35–40 min until deeply caramelised with a wobbly centre. 3. Cool, chill 6 h before slicing.

name: Dark Chocolate Tart
ingredients: Sablé: flour / butter / icing sugar / egg yolk — 150 g / 90 g / 50 g / 1; 70% dark chocolate — 200 g; Cream (35%) — 250 ml; Butter + flaked sea salt — 20 g + pinch
method: 1. Make sablé dough, chill, line the tin and blind-bake 170 °C ≈ 18 min. 2. Pour hot cream over chocolate, stir to ganache, add butter; fill the shell. 3. Set 2 h at room temperature; finish with sea salt.

name: Cardamom Panna Cotta
ingredients: Cream (35%) — 600 ml; Whole milk — 150 ml; Sugar — 70 g; Cardamom pods, crushed — 8; Sheet gelatine (bloomed) — 4 sheets ≈ 8 g; Pistachio + rose-poached fruit — garnish
method: 1. Infuse cream, milk, sugar and cardamom at 80 °C for 15 min; strain. 2. Dissolve bloomed gelatine in the warm cream, pour into glasses. 3. Chill ≥ 6 h; garnish to order.

name: Butter Croissant
ingredients: Bread flour — 1000 g; Water + whole milk — 260 g + 240 g; Sugar / salt / fresh yeast — 120 g / 22 g / 40 g; Butter in dough — 100 g; Laminating butter (82% fat) — 500 g
method: 1. Mix dough, rest cold overnight (4 °C). 2. Enclose the butter block, give 3 single folds with 30 min chilling between. 3. Sheet to 4 mm, cut, shape, proof 2–2.5 h at 26 °C. 4. Egg-wash; bake 190 °C ≈ 18 min.

name: Almond Croissant
ingredients: Day-old butter croissants — 10; Frangipane: butter / sugar / eggs / almond flour / flour — 100 g / 100 g / 2 / 100 g / 10 g; Soak syrup: water + sugar — 100 ml + 50 g; Flaked almonds, icing sugar — to finish
method: 1. Split croissants, brush with syrup, fill with frangipane, close and top with more frangipane and almonds. 2. Bake 170 °C ≈ 12 min; dust with icing sugar.

name: Orange-Cardamom Morning Bun
ingredients: Laminated dough (croissant dough) — 600 g; Butter / sugar — 60 g / 80 g; Orange zest / ground cardamom — 2 oranges / 3 g; Orange glaze — to finish
method: 1. Roll dough to 4 mm, spread with butter, sugar, zest and cardamom. 2. Roll, cut into 6, proof 1.5 h in muffin tins. 3. Bake 180 °C ≈ 25 min; brush with orange glaze.

name: Sesame Honey Financier
ingredients: Brown butter — 125 g; Almond flour / icing sugar / plain flour — 60 g / 125 g / 40 g; Egg whites — 4 (≈ 130 g); Honey / toasted sesame / salt — 20 g / 15 g / 1 g
method: 1. Brown the butter, cool slightly. 2. Mix dry ingredients, whisk in whites and honey, then butter. 3. Rest 1 h, pipe into moulds, top with sesame; bake 190 °C ≈ 12 min.
